messages:
sam: FYI running a RoPE scaling sweep across Mixtral-8B / Mistral-7B variants. Comparing linear vs NTK vs YARN on longctx=64k. Seeing intermittent latency spikes that look like hysteresis when KV cache warms up. Dumping traces now.

maria: Can you paste the trace link? Is this reproducing on dedicated dev pool or only on hosted nodes?

sam: Hosted prod pool first, repros on dedicated dev1 too. Trace: https://internal.perf/trace/1912345678 : spikes align with big prefix hits and then a sustained >20% token p99 increase for ~3s.

devon: Pasted a quick perf summary from perf_cli:
```
model: mixtral-8b
variant: ntk-rope
seq: 64000
batch: auto
kv_mem: dynamic
p50: 32ms
p95: 120ms
p99: 420ms (spike)
cpu: kernel-switch at step 4021
```
looks like kernel selection flips when effective seq length estimation reaches threshold.

alex: Could be the batching heuristics + kernel selector reacting to effective_seq_length jitter. When steady-state we pick kernel A (fast) but occasional longer prefixes push it to kernel B (higher overhead). Suggest adding a hysteresis window in selector to avoid flapping.

ying: Also worth checking head_kv_dims. Mixtral variants we've tuned to 16->32 heads ratio; mis-sized heads can magnify RoPE interpolation error and trigger fallback code paths that allocate temp buffers.

devon: I attached a heap graph (small): memory bump correlates with buffer reallocs at selector change points. If we disable dynamic KV mem and pin to pooled allocation, spikes disappear in local repro.

perf-bot: perf/regression alert: mixtral-8b:ntk-rope p99 tokens increased 22% vs baseline across canary at 2026-11-03T12:03Z. CI job 6678 flagged. Link: https://ci.internal/jobs/6678

maria: Good find. Can we get a minimal repro script to exercise the kernel flip quickly? If so we can add a unit that forces stable kernel choice.

sam: repro script here (short):
```
for prefix in range(300,66000,400):
  send_request(model='mixtral-8b', ropemode='ntk', prefix_len=prefix)
  sleep(0.05)
```
Triggers in ~11s for me.

alex: Plan proposal:
- short-term: add 500-token hysteresis to kernel selector + pooled KV allocation toggle per-instance (config flag)
- mid-term: make batching heuristic aware of effective_seq_length distribution instead of instant estimate
- long-term: add a cheap online estimator to avoid bouncing when work inflight skews seq estimation

ying: Agree. Also run head_kv dim sweep for the variants we ship; we might find safe ranges where RoPE interpolation doesn't force extra code paths.

tia: Ops note: if we ship selector hysteresis, gate behind rollout and monitor p50/p95/p99 and OOM counts. Rollout to canary then 10% then 50%.

devon: I'll prototype pooled KV toggle and hysteresis patch today, push to canary pipeline. Will attach microbench and logs.

sam: Thanks. If anyone can reproduce on other models (qwen or llama), please drop notes here — would be useful to see if it's Mixtral-specific behavior or generic selector/kv combo.

maria: I'll try with Mistral-7B tomorrow morning. If nothing else, we should document the safe ranges for RoPE scaling per model in the runtime tuning guide.

perf-bot: note: created perf ticket PERF-8429 for follow-up tracking. @sam @devon assigned.

sam: sweet. tagging this thread with #ropecase and linking to the triage doc: https://docs.internal/ropes/triage-1912345678

devon: first patch pushed to branch rope-hysteresis-prototype, CI queued.

alex: awesome. :thumbsup:
